reason: User authorized expanded model competition, Optuna tuning, chronological cross-validation and ensembles after M03 established last-slot value; repeat fixed-setting M03 if the selected model or its settings change.
secondary_target: target_mean will be checked with the selected configuration in the follow-up, without a second broad optimization
inner_rule: For each validation month, fit on all eligible rows strictly before that month. Calendar-month boundaries, not row-count TimeSeriesSplit, because invalid dates create gaps. No random train/test split. One-hour labels are observed before next-hour forecast origin; no overlapping future target window and no extra gap is imposed.
outer_rule: All tuning, ensemble member/weight selection occurs only inside each outer training period. Refit on all outer training rows, freeze for that evaluation month and update observed lag inputs hourly. This is sequential one-hour prediction, not month-ahead forecasting.

optuna.extension_rule: After 30 trials, extend to 50 only if the best inner CV MAE improves at least 1 percent over the best of the first 20 trials. No further extension or search-range expansion based on outer performance.
optuna.pruner: NopPruner; every candidate sees every inner month

ensembles.mean5: Equal average of five tuned families
ensembles.weighted_top3: Choose top 3 by inner CV MAE and optimize nonnegative weights summing to one for 50 Optuna trials on cached inner out-of-fold predictions; apply fixed members and weights to outer evaluation. Inner score is optimistic due to selection and is not a performance claim.
ensembles.stacking: Deferred: small set of independent development months and added meta-model selection complexity; first test simple and weighted averaging.

provisional_selection: Lowest pooled outer-development MAE. Within 1 percent prefer existing HGB_B, then single models, then mean5, then weighted_top3. Publish all monthly, peak under/over, profile and transition tradeoffs. Outer development chooses family and therefore is not an independent final test. Final M05 tolerances remain separate.
M03_followup: If the selected family, ensemble, or HGB settings differ from existing HGB_B, freeze each outer split's selected B-tuned configuration (including ensemble weights) and compare A/B and C_A/C_B on identical rows. No retuning on A/C; report B-selection dependence. Keep old M03 results.
prohibited: outer evaluation used for early stopping
rewriting prior M02/M03 results as if planned before observation
